target.description: Id of exactly one {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); {group} ids are rejected

view.description: `users`: a page of users without personal fields; `user`: the one user named in `login`, with e-mail and personal fields; `logins`: a page of the users logged in with a client

login.description: The login of the user to show; required for and only allowed with the view `user`

offset.description: Position of the first entry of the page, e.g. the nextOffset of the last page; only with `users` and `logins`

limit.description: Number of entries of one page; only with `users` and `logins`
